title: post-chat-message
description: Send a message and get the answer

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to send the message to. Defaults to the default Elastic AI agent.

conversation_id.description: The ID of an existing conversation to continue. Omit it to start a new conversation; the response carries the ID to reuse on the next call.

message.description: The user message to send to the agent.
